actual_scope: At p=19, is 319/100 strictly below p^10, and hence is the normalized Schur inverse 2-norm strictly below that envelope?
scope_change_reason: The inverse 2-norm is strictly below 319/100. The named next step is the comparison of 319/100 with 19^10.
bottleneck_link: FINE-PRIME.md uses a 2-norm envelope p^10. On this section the inverse 2-norm is strictly below 319/100, and 319/100 is strictly below 19^10 = 6131066257801.
stop_rule: Stop once 319/100 is compared with 19^10. Do not bound the 2-norm of the matrix itself.
